title: UI风格#204 - Bauhaus Geometric (包豪斯几何)
description: 创建第204种UI风格：包豪斯几何风格 - 基础几何、原色、抽象构图。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGV.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Geometric style When color palette Then features primary red, blue, yellow with black and white
Given Bauhaus Geometric style When typography Then uses geometric sans: Futura, Avant Garde, Circular
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Futura (几何), Avant Garde (装饰), Circular (现代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Geometric style When layout Then basic shapes composition, primary color blocks, grid system
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：基础形状构图、原色块、网格系统

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Geometric style When UI elements Then circle, square, triangle, primary color emphasis
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：圆形、方形、三角形、原色强调

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Geometric UI When functional Then includes form chat, element agents, design stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：形式聊天、元素代理、设计统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Geometric UI When copy Then uses design: 'Form', 'Color', 'Shape', 'Space'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'FORM. COLOR. SHAPE.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'COMPOSE'、'DEPLOY'→'ARRANGE'
